summary.description: The npm package `flatmap-stream` (v0.1.1) was malicious and was added as a dependency of `event-stream` v3.3.6. The malicious code could execute arbitrary JavaScript when the package was required.

affected_packages.name: event-stream
affected_packages.notes: Version 3.3.6 includes `flatmap-stream` 0.1.1 as a transitive dev dependency.

affected_packages.name: flatmap-stream
affected_packages.fixed_version: none – the package should be removed entirely.

recommendations: For projects depending on `event-stream`, downgrade to version 3.3.4 or upgrade to any 4.x release.
Remove any direct dependency on `flatmap-stream` or replace it with a safe alternative.
Regenerate the lockfile after updating/removing the packages to ensure no malicious versions remain.

context_in_repository.issue: Historical lockfile pins `event-stream`@3.3.6 and `flatmap-stream`@0.1.1, which are known malicious versions.
context_in_repository.proposed_change: Replace `event-stream` version 3.3.6 with 3.3.4 and remove the `flatmap-stream` entry from the lockfile.

summary.assessment: The advisory is well‑documented in the official GitHub Advisory Database and references the original incident on the event‑stream repository. The versions identified (event‑stream 3.3.6 and flatmap‑stream 0.1.1) are confirmed malicious. No new exploit code is present in the current repository; the issue is limited to the historical lockfile entries.

pipeline.summary: The repository qimingnan/copay at commit 23a0eae16283549d0e53cc4f6a5719d2cca6d89e contains a historic npm lockfile that pins the malicious versions event‑stream 3.3.6 and flatmap‑stream 0.1.1. A proposed diff upgrades event‑stream to 3.3.4 (a safe version) and removes flatmap‑stream entirely.

The proposed rollback targets the known prior event-stream version 3.3.4 with registry metadata and removes the flatmap-stream dependency. The remediation aims to address the critical severity vulnerability (GHSA-mh6f-8j2x-4483) affecting event-stream and flatmap-stream. Validation is pending, including install consistency, compatibility, and full tests, to ensure the rollback does not introduce any issues.

The proposed diff updates the `package-lock.json` of the `qimingnan/copay` repository. It replaces the vulnerable `event-stream` version 3.3.6 (which pulls in the malicious `flatmap-stream` 0.1.1) with version 3.3.4, a known safe release. The `flatmap-stream` entry is removed entirely. Dependency version ranges for several sub‑dependencies of `event-stream` are also adjusted to use more permissive semver selectors (e.g., `~0.1.1` for `duplexer`).
